title: Spooky games made with Unity: Your 2026 Halloween playlist
summary: From cozy vampire sims to co-op nightmares, these are just a few of the standout horror games made with Unity in 2026 – organized by exactly how scared you want to be.
body_markdown:
***Each month we round up the[latest games made with Unity](https://unity.com/blog?topics=made-with-unity) , and 2026 has been a standout year for the horror genre. Some hidden horror gems were lurking in the cozy games, while others disguised themselves as comedies (one is even about ghost dogs).***


***To celebrate Halloween, we rounded up this year's games and a few upcoming releases that fit the spooky season – organized by exactly how scared you want to be. Whether you’re after white-knuckle dread or a cute vampire life sim, there's something here for your October.***


***Every game on this list – from* Pathologic 3 *to* Moonlight Peaks *– was[made with Unity](https://unity.com/made-with-unity) . Follow our[Steam Curator page](https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45049063-Made-With-Unity-Official/) to keep up with new releases year-round.***
